why_best: This tactile approach grounds the identity in human craft and tangible authenticity, making the brand feel genuinely constructed rather than digitally rendered.
why_bad: A standard polished wipe or sleek geometric fade would flatten the visual texture and destroy the sense of deliberate, physical craftsmanship.
trap: A common misstep is treating the stroke generation as purely fluid vector paths, missing the tiny organic imperfections and terminal accents that sell the impression of real material work.
